bestBets.overview: CAT CALL didn't see out 1200m last time but led throughout over 1000m the start prior. He was dominant at his last try on synthetic and should take plenty of catching with the light impost. His stablemate RALPHIE has been successful at three of five tries here and will be strong late, especially if they overdo it up front. MISSILE ONE scored a tough on-pace win fresh and will only be improved. SPIRIT OF BRODIE battled rising in grade at Eagle Farm but should get every chance to bounce back from the inside alley.

raceTips.comment: Cat Call is quick however the 1150m trip might just be a little too far for him, likely gives a good sight however just a concern late. Spirit Of Brodie is back in grade & far better suited than his previous couple of outings. He loves the surface & with the claim looks to get in ok weight wise. Should the pattern of the day suit those running on late Lady Shotgun is in with a show, fitter for the close-up fresh effort.
